stories.title: Energy giant ENGIE discloses data breach affecting customers
stories.summary: French energy giant ENGIE, one of the world's largest power and natural gas providers, confirmed that attackers stole customer data after breaching a marketing platform used by business partners.

stories.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: This2Shell, That2Shell, Everything's an RCE? Rogue AI, Supply Chain Chaos and More
stories.summary: This2Shell, That2Shell, Everything2Shell. That's pretty much how the last week went. Critical bugs that let attackers run code remotely are showing up everywhere. Hackers are scanning for targets, some flaws are already being used in attacks, and security teams have more urgent patches than they can keep up with. And that's not even the full story. stories.title: PHP2Shell security flaws now sucessfully exploited in the wild
stories.summary: Two critical RCE vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619), collectively tracked as PHP2Shell, have been successfully exploited in the wild.

stories.title: University of Copenhagen data breach exposes data of 525,000 people
stories.summary: The University of Copenhagen in Denmark confirmed that hackers accessed one of its test environments containing personal data belonging to 525,000 people.

stories.title: This is Fine: What NetScaler Zero-Days Tell Us About the New Normal
stories.summary: Keep your patch management pipelines primed in case another round of Citrix NetScaler patches get released soon.

stories.title: CISA Confirms Active Exploitation of Two PHP2Shell Flaws Enabling Remote Code Execution
stories.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Monday confirmed active exploitation of the recently patched PHP2Shell flaws by adding them to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog. The PHP vulnerabilities, both rated 9.2 on the CVSS scoring system, facilitate unauthenticated remote code execution on affected deployments - CVE-2026-109618 - An out-of-memory

stories.title: CISA confirms PHP2Shell vulnerabilities now exploited in attacks
stories.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities to its catalog of actively exploited security flaws and ordered federal agencies to patch their systems by Thursday.

stories.title: Microsoft releases emergency .NET patches for critical Brotli flaw
stories.summary: Microsoft released emergency .NET security updates to patch a critical vulnerability known as Broccoli2Shell, also tracked as Node2Shell and HTTP2Shell.

cves.name: PHP Memory Corruption Vulnerability

Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
